scope: Independent NumPy/SciPy raw sufficient-statistic, locked calibration, same-file contrast, stored-token predictor and routing reaggregation. No primary statistic import, GPU call, or repeated old-CP preflight.
scope_limits: All intervals fixed observed cohort and locked maps, jointly resampled input files, not seed treatment-effect CIs.
S and R reuse the very same trained seed1; shared student pairs dependent.
One particular shared random gate; native-vs-random comparison retains gate scale/margins/boundaries and cannot isolate semantics.
Within-cohort stability does not establish different between-cohort organizations or strict same-function decompositions.
Initial-to-final physical row overlap is not invariant to a global expert relabeling; does not prove quotient partition reorganization or early fingerprint erasure.
Actual components combine support, weight and content; no pure-content attribution.
KL/top1 stored-token metric reaggregation only; full vocabulary distributions were not saved/recomputed.
